title: chat-filenode: mayModifyContent false on Directories blocks all file edits
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 #permissions says mayModifyContent is false on every Directory. Under draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-19 (and -18), Files have no myRights and take their parent Directory's rights, so no File content in a Space tree can ever be replaced (FileNode/set blobId or Direct HTTP Write).
close_reason: Fixed permission table and root rules in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 #permissions to match filenode-19 rights model
